---
name: Public image metadata
description: Privacy handling for user-provided photos placed on public websites
---

Strip EXIF/GPS and other embedded metadata from user-provided photos before copying or converting them into public website assets. Keep original uploads untouched and use optimized, metadata-free derivatives in the site.

**Why:** Uploaded phone photos included location metadata, which could expose capture locations if served unchanged.

**How to apply:** When adding personal photos to public assets, auto-orient, resize/compress, strip metadata, and verify the generated files before using them.
